company.name: RecXchange Portal LLC
company.description:
RecXchange One Pager (Dec 2025) - https://recxchange.io/one-pager

RecXchange is an operating system where recruiters work on real roles and earn fees.

Recruiters use RecXchange to access live roles from real clients, submit candidates, and collaborate securely with other recruiters.

The system replaces fragmented tools such as WhatsApp, email, and spreadsheets by keeping recruiter collaboration and fee-earning work in one place.

Recruiters can explore the system for free. Paid access removes friction once a recruiter shows intent to earn.

RecXchange is UAE registered and operates globally.
